tooltip.skiller.skill_tips: Press Alt to view skills, ↑/↓ to select
skill.skiller.dust_sweep.desc: Pulls nearby dropped items toward you; items can be picked up _the moment they arrive_. Triggered by right-clicking a block or holding the bound skill key. While the key is held, affected items are _highlighted with an outline_.
skill.skiller.chain_mine.desc: Right-click a block in the _whitelist tag_ to _chain-break every block of the same type_ around it within range; the drops gather _at your feet_. Hold the bound skill key and aim at a whitelisted block to _preview the affected blocks_.
